title.narrative: Designing Policy Approaches Under Article 6

description.narrative: The project will take place in two phases. First, a scoping phase will undertake an initial assessment at national level of policies and sectors to identify potential opportunities in a number of GGGI Member and Partner countries. The scoping phase will reduce a long list of 8 countries (Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Vietnam, Indonesia, Morocco, Thailand and Senegal) to a short-list of up to 4 countries for the second phase. The initial countries listed above were identified through an assessment of GGGI member and partner country’s economic size and NDC composition. The second phase will further develop these policy approach potentials in up to 4 countries. Activities in the second phase will run largely in parallel.

This project will support host countries to engage in international carbon transactions through the design of policy approaches under Article 6. The project will support host countries to develop policy approaches with a carbon price output that enables them to undertake national-level emission reductions. As with all of GGGI’s work, any intervention will need to have full country ownership and implementation will be country led – GGGI will act as enabling partner supporting the government as and when needed.
